title: feat(record-page): on a phone the bottom bar holds the object's own actions only; Edit moves into the top bar's More
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbVF7sWPNE4HmjkgyaVxQYif)_
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRaJbQ4vqdv4J5peqA

Fixes #36151

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no published skill under `skills/` names `mobileMaxVisible`, the phone record page's bottom bar or its Edit button (searched); the authoring change is one budget's meaning, taught in the spec describe and `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` here.

## 维护者速读

- 手机上打开记录页：底部按钮条只放这个对象自己的动作（最多两个，撑满一行）；没有动作的对象不再出现底部条，内容一直到屏幕底部；「编辑」挪进右上角「更多」。电脑端不变。
- 手机记录页改版的一步：字段已能点一下直接改，底部那颗占位的「编辑」按钮不再需要，把底部留给真正的业务动作。
- 出错时，手机用户会找不到整页编辑的入口，或看到空白的底部条；把本次改动撤回即可恢复原样，不涉及数据。
- 无。

## What changes

On a phone (the console's record page, `phonePage`), per the card's five ruled items:

1. **Edit leaves the bottom bar.** The record's Edit is forced into the `⋯` on the phone (`component: 'action:menu'` on the host's `sys_edit`, always, not only when Edit is off). A field's value is edited by one tap on it (#36147, PR #36234); whole-record edit is ⋯ → Edit, which calls the same `onEdit` handler the bar's Edit called (inline edit state on an object without a form, the form route on one with a form).
2. **The bottom bar holds the object's own actions only**: the primary, then the next one, budget unchanged (`PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS` = 2, or the authored `mobileMaxVisible`), filling the row (`flex-1`). The edit state keeps its Cancel and Save there.
3. **No action, no bar.** With nothing to draw the toolbar returns nothing and the host's bar hides itself (`:has(> [role=toolbar]:empty)` / no toolbar), so the body runs to the foot of the screen.
4. **Approval unchanged.** A record pending the reader's approval still draws [Approve][Reject][⋯] from `RecordHeaderStateContext`'s state group with its own `⋯`; the top bar draws no second `⋯` then (one `⋯` per screen).
5. **Everything else is in the top bar's `⋯`**, at the right end of `RecordTopBar` (its `frame` slot): actions past the budget, Refresh, Edit (on or off with its reason), Favorites, Share, Delete.

Mechanism:

- `PageHeaderPhoneFace` (the `PageHeaderPhoneContext` value, a host slot, never metadata) gains an optional `more: HTMLElement | null`. `PageHeaderActions` in its bar face portals the `⋯` there when a host hands it; a host that does not hand it keeps the `⋯` as the bar's last button, byte-for-byte as before (the legacy pins in `page-header-phone-bar-27058.test.tsx` are untouched and green).
- `RecordDetailView` hands a `span[data-record-phone-more]` it mounts in the top bar's `frame`.
- Desktop: no change (the `face: 'row'` path is not touched).

Spec / docs: `page:header` `mobileMaxVisible` describe now says the phone bar holds the page's own actions and Edit is in the top bar's `⋯`; generated docs regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, `gen-sdui-reference.mjs`), hand-written `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` and the designer's config description updated to match. Semantic change: an unset budget now shows two page actions where it showed Edit + one, and an authored value counts the page's actions alone.

Rulings carried (not reopened): the card's five items; the maintainer's 「可以，立卡」 on fig. 48; ruling 7066516044 item 2 (a single tap edits on the phone). Linked rules this card reverses, as the claim names: #34595 (the bottom bar starts with Edit), and the Edit-counted half of #35840 (two visible by default: still two, now both page actions).

## Tests

Step 0 (owed before Edit leaves the bar): every field type the default record page draws editable was checked at 375 px with touch emulation on the live showcase Field Zoo record: one tap on the value opens its editor, and the edit saves (a PATCH carrying that field's key). **All pass; no type raised.**

| Result | Types |
|---|---|
| one tap opens, saves | textarea, email, url, phone, markdown, number, currency, percent, date, datetime, time, boolean, toggle, select, multiselect, radio, checkboxes, tags, lookup, lookups (multiple), master_detail, tree, user, users, owner (current_user default), location, address, code, json, color, rating, slider, signature, qrcode, progress, the system Owner |
| not drawn editable (same on desktop, `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES` / read-only by kind) | password, secret, html, richtext, formula, autonumber |
| not drawn as a detail row | media, embedded and vector types |

Pins updated where they pinned the reversed behaviour:

- `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx` (the #34595 pins): the bar is [Convert Lead][Assign] with no `⋯`; the `⋯` is the top bar's last control and holds Edit and Share; a third action folds into the top `⋯` before Edit; one action fills the row; no action leaves an empty, hidden bar and ⋯ → Edit calls `onEdit`; the approval control and the Edit-off cases read the top `⋯`.
- `RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678.test.tsx`: the phone branch reads the empty bottom bar and the top bar's `⋯`.
- `page-header-phone-bar-27058.test.tsx`: new `the phone bar with the host's top-bar ⋯ slot` describe (two actions fill the row and the `⋯` sits in the slot; no page action draws an empty bar; slot not yet mounted draws no `⋯`).
- `ui/e2e/record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts`: the geometry fixture draws the top bar's More (`h-11 w-11`) and an actions-only bar; 6 passed locally.

Ablations (one-shot, not kept; both restored, blob == HEAD verified by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`):

- `RecordDetailView`: Edit forced into the `⋯` only when off (the old rule) ⇒ phoneFace suite 6 failed / 22 passed.
- `PageHeaderActions`: top-bar slot ignored (`moreInTopBar = barFace && false`) ⇒ 13 failed / 29 passed across the two suites.

Readings on the final head `ec741d2c08`:

- `vitest run --maxWorkers=1` phoneFace-27058 + recordPageTiers-26678 + page-header-phone-bar-27058 (under the verify lock): Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 52 passed (52), exit 0.

- `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`, so the edited tests are in): VERDICT command-exit 0, after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure (a stale `@object-ui/types` dist had first reported a `DataTableSchema.onColumnHide` error outside this diff; rebuilt, gone).
- Earlier on this branch, before the last test-only commit: RecordDetailView*, page-header*, record-top-bar* suites 133 files / 1144 tests, the one red being the tiers pin fixed in `ec741d2c08`; ESLint on the changed files 0 errors.

## Acceptance notes

- Edit is in the top `⋯` on the phone in every state, including the record's edit state (where the bar is Cancel/Save).
- A host button on the phone (the queue's Claim) still sits in the bar ahead of the page actions and counts toward the budget, as before.
- Overlap: #36357 also regenerates `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` (a generated sha/date pair); whichever lands second regenerates it. Clean against #36438, #36392, #36351, #36343 and origin/main.
- Out of scope, reported to the seat (not fixed here): in the lookup picker on a phone, an option's preview carries a record chip link; a tap on the chip navigates away mid-edit instead of selecting (Field Zoo, Master-Detail → Project, tap the "Account: Fabrikam" chip ⇒ the account page opens).

## Verification

Read first (by risk):

1. `PageHeaderActions` in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`: the `moreInTopBar` branch (the portal into the host slot and the early return that leaves the bar empty).
2. `RecordDetailView` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: `sys_edit`'s phone `component: 'action:menu'`, the top bar's `frame` slot and the bar's empty-hide class.
3. `PageHeaderPhoneFace` in `page-header-phone-context.ts`: the new optional `more`.

Two-minute check: open any record of an object with no actions of its own (showcase Account) at 375 px wide ⇒ no bottom bar, a `⋯` at the top bar's right end holding Refresh / Edit / Add to favorites / Share / Delete. A showcase Task ⇒ [Log Time][Archive] filling the bottom row.
